method.aggregation: per-trial median of complete windows; paired repeats across independently restarted scenario blocks
method.rotation: cyclic condition order by block and scenario; all conditions start from default
method.agent: actual live_agent.py unchanged; same global goals across scenarios; includes policy transition windows
method.measurement: same maximum 5 HTTP probes per sampling cycle under every condition
method.background: clipped overlap of timestamped stdout reports; >=80% coverage and <2s delivery spread
method.processes: same workload PIDs across conditions in a block; freshly restarted between blocks
method.scope: single VMware guest; descriptive repeats, not general optimality or significance
